map.环境温度校正近似线性，每升高 1℃ 降约 1.67%，60℃ 降到 0.50；精: Ambient-temperature correction is approximately linear, dropping about 1.67% per 1 °C and reaching 0.50 at 60 °C; for exact values consult GB/T 16895.15
map.多芯成束敷设相互加热，3 芯成束约 0.87，根数多可低至 0.6~0.7: Multi-core cables bundled together heat each other; three cores bundled is about 0.87, falling to 0.6~0.7 with more cores

map.温度系数为什么是线性下降？: Why does the temperature factor decrease linearly?
map.在 30~60℃ 区间，电缆载流量的环境温度校正通常近似为线性（本工具取每升高: In the 30~60 °C range, the ambient-temperature correction of cable ampacity is usually approximated as linear (this tool uses −1.67% per 1 °C, reaching 0.50 at 60 °C). For more precise values consult GB/T 16895.15 (IEC 60364-5-52), tabulated by insulation material type (PVC/XLPE); heat-resistance ratings differ noticeably between insulation types.
map.多芯系数 0.87 是怎么定的？: How is the multi-core factor 0.87 determined?
map.多根电缆成束敷设时相互加热、散热变差，载流量需折减。0.87 对应常见 3 芯成: When cables are bundled they heat each other and dissipate worse, so ampacity must be derated. 0.87 is a simplified value for common 3-core bundles; in practice look up the correction table by cable count, installation method (tray/conduit/direct burial) and spacing—bundles with many cores can drop to 0.6~0.7, and ignoring it causes long-term overheating.
